subject: Sealed node attestation + VPC evidence & CAIQ items
messages:
From: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@healthtech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@healthtech.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: attestation for EU fenced compute + CAIQ/SOC2 evidence

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well. As part of our procurement security review for the pilot, we need a short pack confirming the following for Redwood’s EU private deployment you propose for us: 

- Sealed/fenced compute node attestation that shows the compute remains within EU-hosted zones (we need a statement + a machine-signed attestation artifact if possible).
- A CAIQ snapshot mapped to the HealthTech questionnaire (we’ll highlight the 12 controls we care about).
- SOC 2: executive summary + date of last assessment and a pointer to the redacted report.
- VPC/private link topology and the set of peering endpoints you expect to provision (IP ranges ok to redact; we need the peering endpoints, expected latency class, and whether flow logs are retained in-region).
- A short ops runbook describing onboarding, emergency fallback (if a node is reprovisioned outside scheduled maintenance), and who to call during the handoff window (names + roles).

Do you have these items available this week? If not, can you confirm which subset you can provide and a delivery ETA? We have an internal security call next Wednesday and it would be ideal to include a short attestation to unblock that conversation.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Dunne
Security & Privacy Lead, HealthTech
alex.dunne@healthtech.com

Attachments: (none)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@healthtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: attestation for EU fenced compute + CAIQ/SOC2 evidence

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely support that scope; below is what we can deliver and the proposed timeline.

What we can provide this week (by EOD Friday):
- Machine-signed sealed-node attestation (JSON blob) for the EU cluster + a brief plain-language attestation statement signed by our CISO. See attached "sealed-node-attestation-20270307.json" and "rwi-ciso-attestation-eu.txt".
- CAIQ mapping: we’ll produce a snapshot with your 12 controls prioritized (we’ll mark items applicable/not-applicable and include references to SOC2 controls). Draft will be in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-runbook (will share with your domain).
- SOC 2: executive summary (redacted) attached as "rwi-soc2-exec-summary-2026.pdf" plus date of last assessment (2026-11-15). Full report requires executed NDA; I’ve included a DocuSign link below that we can use for one-off redacted access.
- VPC topology: initial peering table (CSV) and annotated diagram will be included. IPs will be redacted; we’ll provide endpoint IDs and expected latency class.
- Ops runbook draft: "privatelink-runbook-draft.docx" with onboarding checklist and emergency fallback procedure.

Notes / constraints from our side:
- The machine-signed attestation proves the node boot image and region tag; it does not include customer data artifacts.
- For full SOC 2 report access we need a signed NDA; the DocuSign link below is pre-populated. Alternatively we can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter if faster.

Next steps: please confirm 1) whether redacted IPs are acceptable, 2) whether you want the DocuSign NDA route or a bridge letter, and 3) preferred time window for a 30-minute technical handoff (suggest Tue 2027-03-09 09:00–11:00 CET).

DocuSign (pre-filled): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?example
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/healthtech

I’m looping in Karthik and Grace on the technical bits; Jonas will coordinate logistics.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Evelyn.Hart@redwood.com

Attachments: rwi-soc2-exec-summary-2026.pdf (pdf), sealed-node-attestation-20270307.json (json), vpc-peering-table-20270307.csv (csv), privatelink-runbook-draft.docx (docx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Alex Dunne <alex.dunne@healthtech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-07T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: attestation for EU fenced compute + CAIQ/SOC2 evidence

Alex / team — quick technical clarifications so we provide exactly what you need: 

1) Sealed node attestation: we’ll include a TPM-backed signature from the node image signing service showing the EU region tag and the operator key fingerprint. That artifact is machine-verifiable; we can also provide a short verification script (shell) if you want to validate offline.

2) VPC peering & flow logs: flow logs are retained in-region for EU clusters by default for 90 days. We can optionally extend retention and provide an ingest export to your SIEM (S3 compatible endpoint) — that requires an ops request and timeline of ~3 business days.

3) HSM/KMS: keys used for model-serving session tokens are partitioned per-tenant within the EU HSM cluster; we can provide a KMS partitioning diagram and key rotation cadence. Please note we do not escrow customer keys.

4) CAIQ mapping: we’ll mark controls where we rely on customer configuration (e.g., network ACLs) as "shared responsibility". If you can flag those 12 items in the spreadsheet I’ll highlight our controls vs your obligations.

Redaction guidance: we will redact internal operator IPs and on-call phone numbers in the public pack; however we can provide operator roster under NDA.

Delivery plan: I’ll produce the verification script + KMS partition diagram by Thursday EOD (2027-03-10 UTC) and Grace will finalize the runbook checklist.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
